tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: MCP Canary plans, monthly prices (in cents), and limits, plus the free trial. The trial needs no payment and starts on the first monitor write.

tools.name: inspect_endpoint
tools.description: Connects to a remote MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, then legacy SSE), lists its tools, and classifies each tool's side effects from its MCP hints. Never calls a tool on the target. A target problem is status=failed with a stable failure code (e.g. TARGET_UNAVAILABLE, TARGET_AUTH_FAILED, MCP_PROTOCOL
